reconcile.note: Henry treats Zion as the seat of God's gracious nearness and heaven as the seat of his glory, calling Zion a type rather than a literal rival residence.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Where does God dwell?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/zion.html) (2001).

sides.snippet: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion
sides.verseText: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, And declare among the people what he has done.

sides.snippet: God is in heaven, and you on earth
sides.verseText: Don't be rash with your mouth, and don't let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
